title: Stage gates
intro: The product gates G1 to G6 of this transformation: readiness of every required output, submission and the approver's decision.
businessApprovalBody: A stage gate is a business approval decided by the configured approver, a person. This software checks readiness and records the decision; it never approves anything itself.

approverBasis.configured_role: Decided as a holder of the configured approver role
approverBasis.default_role: Decided as a holder of the default approver role

readinessIntro: Evaluated now from the recorded data. Unverified evidence never completes an output that needs verified evidence.
unverifiedNote: Unverified: does not count until a reviewer verifies it.
notEnabledBody: Submission of this gate becomes available in a later release.
anyRoleHolder: Any holder of this role on the transformation
reloaded: The gate was reloaded with the current data.

submit.title: Submit {{code}} for decision
submit.description: This freezes a snapshot of the required outputs and their evidence and sends it to the approver. A pending earlier submission is superseded.
submit.incompleteWarning: Only {{complete}} of {{total}} mandatory outputs are complete. The submission will be refused until they all are.
submit.blocked: Submission opens when every mandatory output is complete ({{complete}} of {{total}} now).

decision.title: Decision on {{code}}, submission #{{n}}
decision.description: Your business decision as the configured approver. The rationale is mandatory and is recorded with your name, the submission number and the time.

configure.title: Approver of {{code}}
configure.description: Choose the approver role and, optionally, a named person holding it. Not possible while a submission is pending.
configure.userHint: Optional. Without a name, any holder of the role on this transformation can decide.

history.title: Submission history
history.intro: Every submission keeps its frozen snapshot and, once decided, the decision with its rationale.
history.noDecision: No decision recorded for this submission.

agreements.intro: Playbook Gate 1 rule (B0032): do not proceed with a list of projects; proceed only when the leadership team agrees on the problem, the baseline and the material value pools. Confirm each agreement; your confirmations are recorded with your decision.

item.problem: The leadership team agrees on the problem
item.baseline: The leadership team agrees on the baseline
item.materialValuePools: The leadership team agrees on the material value pools

agreements.blocked: Tick all three confirmations to approve G1.

missing.problem: Not confirmed: agreement on the problem
missing.baseline: Not confirmed: agreement on the baseline
missing.materialValuePools: Not confirmed: agreement on the material value pools

problem.required: G1 approval requires leadership agreement on the problem, the baseline and the material value pools (B0032). Nothing was recorded.
problem.notApplicable: Leadership agreement confirmations apply only to approving G1. Nothing was recorded.

inheritedApproval.label: Inherited approval

status.pending_verification: Inherited approval: pending verification (does not approve this gate)
status.accepted: Inherited approval: accepted, counts for sequencing (does not approve this gate)
status.acceptedNotCounting: Inherited approval: accepted, does not count now (does not approve this gate)
status.rejected: Inherited approval: rejected (does not approve this gate)
status.revoked: Inherited approval: revoked (does not approve this gate)

inheritedApproval.source: Approved earlier by {{body}} on {{date}}; recorded as evidence, not as a decision on this gate.

exception.title: Gate exceptions
exception.intro: An exception lets one mandatory criterion be submitted incomplete. It needs a reason, a scope, a compensating action with an owner and an expiry date, and it is decided by the gate's configured approver. It covers the criterion only while today is on or before its expiry date; after that the criterion is missing again.
exception.empty: No exception has been requested for this gate.
exception.requestDescription: The exception is a request until the gate's configured approver accepts it. All fields are required.
exception.expiresOnHint: The exception covers the criterion up to and including this date.
exception.decideDescription: Accepting lets this criterion be submitted incomplete until the expiry date. It does not approve the gate.
exception.withdrawBody: The request is withdrawn and the approver's task is cancelled. Only the requester can do this.
exception.revokeDescription: From now on the criterion is missing again. A pending submission that relied on this exception cannot be approved.
exception.requesterCannotDecide: Requested by you: the approver decides.
exception.businessApproval: a decision on an exception is a business approval inside the product by the gate's configured approver. It never approves an engineering delivery gate.
exception.expired: Expired on {{date}}: no longer covers the criterion

review.title: Criteria review
review.dialogDescription: A review records a finding and a recommendation for one criterion. The first review puts the gate Under review. It is not the gate decision, which stays with the configured approver.
review.submitterCannot: You submitted this gate, so you cannot review it.

scale.title: Approved scale scope
scale.intro: A G5 approval records where the transformation may scale: each item names one initiative and one business unit. Scaling outside this scope is refused.
scale.notApproved: G5 is not approved: no scale scope has been approved, so no scaling is allowed yet.
scale.editorHint: A G5 approval must name each initiative and business unit it allows to scale. Conditions are optional and each needs an owner and a due date.
scale.itemIncomplete: Each scope item needs an initiative and a business unit.
scale.conditionIncomplete: Each condition needs a text, an owner and a due date.
scale.duplicate: Each initiative and business unit pair can appear only once.
scale.invalid: The scale scope is not valid.

modularLinks.title: Missing Modular-entry links at submission
modularLinks.waiverUsed: Submitted under an accepted waiver of the missing baseline and outcome links. The waiver does not supply the links.

modularWaiver.kindHint: Modular transformation: inherited approvals of G1-G3 granted before this product was used. A waiver applies here only to G3 for the whole transformation, and covers only the missing baseline and outcome links; any other waiver is refused.
modularWaiver.label: Waiver of the missing baseline and outcome links
modularWaiver.decideDescription: Accepting lets G3 be submitted while the baseline and outcome links are still missing, until the expiry date. It supplies no link and does not approve the gate.

tableRegion.dispositions: Table of open risks and their dispositions (scrollable)

scaleTransition.title: Scale transitions
scaleTransition.intro: Scaling an initiative into a business unit is allowed only after the G5 business approval and only inside its approved scale scope. The server checks both.
scaleTransition.formIntro: Choose the initiative and the business unit. Outside the approved G5 scope, or before G5 is approved, the request is refused.
scaleTransition.empty: No initiative has been scaled yet.

riskDisposition.title: Risk dispositions
riskDisposition.intro: G5 needs every open High-impact risk closed or given an approved disposition (Risk closure). Propose a disposition for an open risk here; a person other than the proposer decides it.
riskDisposition.businessApproval: A risk disposition is decided in a business approval inside the product. Only an approved disposition completes Risk closure; a pending one does not.
riskDisposition.noOpenRisks: No open risk in the RAID register.
riskDisposition.formIntro: The disposition is immutable once proposed and goes to a business approval.
